The '''Lair of the Eyeless''' was the heart of the [[rakghoul tunnels]] that were located on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]; all of which were inhabited by huge creatures called the [[Eyeless]] and an army of [[rakghoul]]s.
